note: Four defects seen on the live site, all fixed at their owner. The gallery was cut by a hairline between batches — right for an even grid, wrong for a natural-ratio collage. A <section class="intro"> was given the 728px reading measure, so the raised tone painted only half the width and read as a stray box. The presence intro ran on three axes at once: kicker and link at 158px, heading centred at 454, copy centred at 246. And the timeline year track was minmax(88px,auto), which WebKit lets grow to the max-content of whatever lands in it — capped at 8rem, and the children are now pinned to their columns so nothing can land there. Menu descriptions rewritten: Exhibitions had none at all.
